title: Headroom context compression, kept per machine
summary: How to run the Headroom compression proxy on one machine without committing it: a pinned install, a launch script with a clean environment and its egress switches, and a guard that keeps proxy routing, Headroom wiring and its local state out of git.
postInstall: For a person, to relay — the session that installs or updates the kit does none of these steps, which act on someone's own machine, not on the project.
Nothing runs Headroom for you: each person who wants it installs it on their own machine (docs/conventions/headroom.md § Install), at the pinned version, never in CI.
Before relying on it, read § What the proxy sees and keeps: every prompt, file and credential of the session crosses it. Check that this fits your provider's terms and your plan.

Start the proxy only with the launch script of the page (§ The launch script), saved outside the repository, then give ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to the one claude process you start yourself (§ Start a session).

Do not run `headroom wrap`, `headroom init`, `headroom mcp install`, `headroom learn` or the headroom-marketplace plugins: they write user-wide settings, register a server for every agent, or send transcripts to a model (§ Left out).
HR-1 refuses any committed gateway URL and any proxy variable in a workflow, whatever the job: read § Not for every project before keeping this module in a project that has one.
This piece has never run live: do the live check (§ Live check) once before trusting it.
